想提前布置机关，可以使用近感晶雷、休眠晶体和空心载荷卵。它们不会随时间消失，随世: Set traps with Proximity Crystal Mines, Dormant Crystals and Hollow Payload Eggs. They do not expire and are saved with the world. Mines wait for enemies; Dormant Crystals respond to Detonate Crystals. Eggs release their stored spells when broken by a valid attacker, who becomes the payload's caster, even if the placer is offline. Gusts push eggs without releasing their payloads and cannot push mines. Both crystal types share the host's optional crystal cap.
唤星法杖与唤月法杖的刻印能在杖头或载体触发点生成原版矮星、极光，整次施法分别至少: Star Caller's Staff and Moon Caller's Staff engravings create native Dwarf Stars and Polar Lights at the wand tip or carrier trigger point. Their total cast cooldowns are at least 4 minutes and 1 minute respectively. Speed Up adds initial velocity; Homing and Short-Range Homing can start stationary entities moving, while Rotate Toward Enemies only changes direction. Moving entities and stars share projectile trajectories. They stop and remain after hitting a target or wall; piercing and bounce modifiers can change this. Permanent crystals and eggs have drag, which ongoing thrust may overcome; stars keep their native lifetime. Target selection applies only to the current cast group. Giant Shot enlarges both visuals and effective areas of ranged and static projectiles, instant blasts and melee attacks without increasing damage. Its multipliers add: one card ×2.5, two ×5, three ×7.5. Star light, temperature and sanity radii grow too. See the archive for details and recipes.
用「续航铭文」延长飞行弹体寿命，或用「缩短寿命」将寿命减半，多张倍率相乘。延寿没: Lifetime Inscription extends flight; Shorter Lifetime halves it. Multiple multipliers multiply, with no upper lifetime cap. Use them to adjust travel distance or orbit duration. Total travel distance is unlimited by default, with an optional world limit. Payload nesting is also unlimited by default, with an optional 1–30-level cap. Out-of-bounds cleanup and permanent motion cleanup are off by default. When enabled, the latter removes moving permanent crystals and eggs that have spent 16 continuous minutes in native sleeping regions, but only while their shard total exceeds 20. The absence timer runs even below that threshold, caps at 20 minutes, and resets on entering an active region. Stars, static fields and permanent traps keep their own persistence rules.

施放与充能更快、魔力回涌较好，魔力储量和容量略低。: Faster casting and recharge with better regeneration, at the cost of some mana capacity and slots.
魔力储量更高，魔力回涌稍低、充能稍慢。: Higher mana capacity, with slightly lower regeneration and slower recharge.
魔力回涌更高，魔力储量稍低、施放间隔稍长。: Higher regeneration, with slightly lower mana capacity and a longer cast delay.
两次施法之间的基础等待；计入施放修正后最低为零，实际连射仍受人物攻击动作与法术专: Base wait between casts. Cast modifiers can reduce it to zero; character attack animations and spell-specific cooldowns still limit repeated casting.
受《Noita》启发，把法杖编排带进《饥荒联机版》。收集随机法杖与法术卡，按顺序: Inspired by Noita, bring wand building to Don’t Starve Together. Collect random wands and spell cards, arrange their order, and create your own attacks, tools and melodies.
换几张卡，换一种打法: New cards, new ways to cast
追踪 → 火花弹，让火花转向敌人；双重施法 → 火花弹 → 魔法箭，一次出手释放: Homing → Spark Bolt bends shots toward enemies. Double Cast → Spark Bolt → Magic Arrow releases two spells together. Non-shuffle wands follow slot order; shuffle wands mix the deck.
把近战藏进远程载荷: Send melee attacks inside a payload
魔法箭·碰撞 → 旋斧攻击，命中后在远处挥斧。碰撞与定时决定释放时机，晶雷和载荷: Magic Arrow · Collision → Axe Whirl sends a melee attack to the impact point. Collision and timer carriers control when payloads fire; crystals and payload eggs can wait on the battlefield.
在武器刻印台把熟悉的武器与工具刻成法术。暗影收割者沿途采收植物，让战斗法杖也能帮: Engrave familiar weapons and tools at the Weapon Engraving Table. Shadow Reaper harvests plants along its path, turning a combat wand into a useful helper.
鱼食刻印与海钓竿刻印可以组成海钓搭配；池塘钓竿、园艺锄等工具也有各自用途。具体作: Combine Chum and Sea Fishing Rod engravings for ocean fishing. Pond fishing rods and garden hoes have their own uses too; check each card for its effects and limits.
唤星与唤月刻印召唤原版星体，再加入追踪、加速或巨化。巨化扩大星体外观及照明、温度: Summon native stars with Star Caller’s and Moon Caller’s engravings, then add Homing, Speed Up or Giant Projectile. Enlargement expands their appearance and light, temperature and sanity areas without directly increasing damage.
陶笛与弦琴音符卡可搭配升降音修饰。加速与减速会改变音符样本时长，长按施法仍受人物: Combine ocarina and kantele note cards with pitch modifiers. Speed Up and Slow Down change sample duration; holding cast remains subject to character animations and is not an automatic metronome.
演奏实录：《深海少女》片段，使用音符卡组演奏。: Performance: a short passage from Deep Sea Girl, played with note cards.
联机游玩时，服务器与玩家都需安装模组。中英文可由每位玩家独立选择；卡牌掉率、载荷: For multiplayer, install the mod on both the server and each client. Players can choose Chinese or English independently. World settings control card drop rates, payload depth and field entity limits.
《织法之杖》的创意来自《Noita》，由 yuejian 使用 Codex 开发: Inspired by Noita and developed by yuejian with Codex. Share your builds and report issues on GitHub.
重绘局部雷云，保留饥荒手绘风格，增强厚暗云层与内部透光的明暗层次。: Redrawn storm clouds retain Don't Starve-style inked artwork, with dark foreground billows and light transmitted from within.
云层从聚拢到攻击、消散持续翻涌；电光沿云腔传播，短促分叉闪电先消失，余光稍后消退: Clouds keep rolling through formation, attacks and dissipation. Light travels through cloud cavities; brief branching arcs fade before the lingering illumination.
三次预警与落雷采用不同的云内放电路线。: Three distinct internal discharge routes accompany the three warnings and strikes.
略微抬高雷云及落雷起点，闪电顶端藏入云内或云底，并保持镜头旋转与巨型法术下的位置: Clouds and strike origins are slightly higher, with lightning emerging from inside or beneath the cloud. Alignment is retained across camera angles and enlarged spells.
雷云攻击次数、时间、伤害、范围和其他法术玩法保持不变。: Strike count, timing, damage, range and other spell mechanics are unchanged.
升级后请重启游戏与世界；房主与参与玩家均需更新。沿用现有存档格式。: Restart the game and world after updating. Both the host and participating players need the update. The existing save format is retained.

新增「施法方向」设置：可在游戏内打开「向导」随时切换，默认使用「目标选择」。设置: Added Cast Direction: open the in-game Guide to switch at any time. Target Selection is the default. Your choice is saved locally and affects only your player, without changing world settings or other players.
目标选择：选中物体时，朝它的实际位置施法。例如点击 Boss 的头部，也会朝它脚: Target Selection: when an object is selected, cast toward its actual position. For example, selecting a boss's head aims toward its position on the ground.
鼠标方向：始终朝鼠标对应的地面位置施法，不受鼠标悬停物体影响。适合需要精确瞄准地: Mouse Direction: always cast toward the ground position under the cursor, regardless of any hovered object. Useful for aiming at a precise spot on the ground.
